svg.aria-label: Artem Kupratsevich. QA Engineer working remotely from Belgrade, Serbia. Self-test: pass automation: web, iOS, Android and API suites in four frameworks; pass releases: Playwright e2e coverage from 0% to 90%, wired into CI; pass people: led a QA team of five, took interns to full-time hires; pass side work: 13 projects: 9 live, 2 in beta, 2 in progress. 4 passed, 0 failed.
